entries.title: Small Adjustments and Fixes
body: - Fixed a bug which caused animals that are dead to respawn after load
- Top down sprite sorting should now be more reliable
- Reverted amount of days Pigs, Cows and Sheeps survive without food back to 5 days
- Re-added the tooltip for the seed buttons

entries.title: Time & Save Fixes
body: - Fixed an issue where the save and load system didn't accurately save the time of day
- Fixed the day/night cycle so the day counter properly advances at midnight (12:00 AM) instead of sunrise
- Fixed an issue where day/night lighting would slowly fade in when loading a save. The environment now instantly snaps to the correct time of day
- Fixed an issue where time passed at inconsistent speeds during the day and night. The in-game clock now progresses at a steady, consistent rate through all daily phases
- Fixed a bug where shop inventory would incorrectly reset to full stock when loading a saved game. Seed quantities now persist correctly between sessions
- Turned off the Raycast for the fade out image so button clicks can be clickable during load
- Removed some of the lights in the scene that turns on at night

entries.title: Save & Load Update
body: - Added the highly requested save and load system
- Options can now be adjusted directly from the main menu
- Slightly refined overall UI colors for better readability and style
- Removed tooltips due to a UI-related issue (will be revisited in a future update)

entries.title: Small additions and fixes
body: - Added a fullscreen toggle in the pause menu
- Added a resolution dropdown in the pause menu
- Made the transition from main menu to game smoother

entries.title: Hotfix 3
body: - Changed the shop details UI to show what the shop sells instead of who the shop owner is
- Improved the visuals for the shop details UI
- Fixed the colours of butters sell UI

entries.title: Hotfix 2
body: - Fixed an where the info for perks would not display correctly
- Fixed an a small typo issue in Margaine's shop UI

entries.title: Hotfix 1
body: - Some items were left out in the inventory that were used for testing purposes. These items have now been removed

entries.title: Third release
body: - Added volume slider in pause menu
- Added Drag Fertilising Perk
- Added info for perks
- Fixed the box collider for one of the shops
- Deselect items after 15 seconds of inactivity
- Higher priced animals drops more fertiliser
- Fixed a shop displaying the wrong name
- Various bug fixes and quality of life improvements

entries.title: Second release
body: - Added max stocks and restock mechanic
- New Craig spawn points
- Shop names and opening hours can be checked by clicking on the shop
- Added Infected Crops that can be used in a the new Composter to obtain Golden Fertilizer
- Outlines around various interactive objects for better visibility
- Back button added to various menus for easier navigation
- Lofi toggle added to pause menu
- Added a interaction range to the barrels
- Various bug fixes and quality of life improvements

entries.title: First release
body: - Fully functional core gameplay loop
